title: SB7004 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 49, Chapter 1 and Title 49, Chapter 50, relative to private schools.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2023-08-17; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260515001244 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/SB7004.pdf (LegiScan doc 2837631))
provenance.note: Draft dated 2023-08-17 (as filed, special-session number). Section 49-50-803 is the private-school handgun carry policy section (per the state summary); the bill text itself does not mention handguns. The state's summary calls it 'as introduced'; no votes are recorded for this Senate number. The same change was enacted in 2024 as Public Chapter 738 (HB 1631 / SB 1708).

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 49-50-803): is amended by deleting the language "K-12" wherever it appears in the section.
SECTION 2 (TCA 49-50-803, new subsection (f)): (f) As used in this section, "private school" means a private school as defined in § 49-6-3001(c) that serves students in any of the grades pre-kindergarten through twelve (pre-K-12).
